verses.original: בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֗ד בֶּן־ חֵ֤פֶר בֶּן־ גִּלְעָד֙ בֶּן־ מָכִ֣יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בֶן־ יוֹסֵ֑ף וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֹתָ֔יו מַחְלָ֣ה נֹעָ֔ה וְחָגְלָ֥ה וּמִלְכָּ֖ה וְתִרְצָֽה׃ וַתִּקְרַ֜בְנָה
verses.transliteration: bə·nō·wṯ ṣə·lā·p̄ə·ḥāḏ ben- ḥê·p̄er ben- gil·‘āḏ ben- mā·ḵîr ben- mə·naš·šeh lə·miš·pə·ḥōṯ mə·naš·šeh ḇen- yō·w·sêp̄ wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ bə·nō·ṯāw maḥ·lāh nō·‘āh wə·ḥā·ḡə·lāh ū·mil·kāh wə·ṯir·ṣāh wat·tiq·raḇ·nāh
verses.literal: Now the daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher the son of Gilead the son of Machir the son of Manasseh belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph These were the names of his daughters Mahlah Noah Hoglah Milcah and Tirzah They approached

verses.original: פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֖ד וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֜דְנָה לִפְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֗ה וְלִפְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלִפְנֵ֥י הַנְּשִׂיאִ֖ם וְכָל־ הָעֵדָ֑ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel- mō·w·‘êḏ wat·ta·‘ă·mō·ḏə·nāh lip̄·nê mō·šeh wə·lip̄·nê ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·lip̄·nê han·nə·śî·’im wə·ḵāl hā·‘ê·ḏāh lê·mōr
verses.literal: the entrance to the Tent of Meeting stood before Moses . . . Eleazar the priest . . . the leaders and the whole congregation and said

verses.original: אָבִינוּ֮ מֵ֣ת בַּמִּדְבָּר֒ וְה֨וּא הָיָ֜ה לֹא־ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעֵדָ֗ה קֹ֑רַח הַנּוֹעָדִ֛ים עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה בַּעֲדַת־ כִּֽי־ מֵ֔ת בְחֶטְא֣וֹ הָ֥יוּ לֽוֹ׃ לֹא־ וּבָנִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇî·nū mêṯ bam·miḏ·bār wə·hū hā·yāh lō- bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘ê·ḏāh qō·raḥ han·nō·w·‘ā·ḏîm ‘al- Yah·weh ba·‘ă·ḏaṯ- kî- mêṯ ḇə·ḥeṭ·’ōw hā·yū lōw lō- ū·ḇā·nîm
verses.literal: Our father died in the wilderness but he was not among the followers of Korah who gathered together against the LORD . . . Instead he died because of his own sin and he had no sons

verses.original: לָ֣מָּה שֵׁם־ אָבִ֙ינוּ֙ יִגָּרַ֤ע מִתּ֣וֹךְ מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֔וֹ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ בֵּ֑ן תְּנָה־ לָּ֣נוּ אֲחֻזָּ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ אָבִֽינוּ׃ אֲחֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: lām·māh šêm- ’ā·ḇî·nū yig·gā·ra‘ mit·tō·wḵ miš·paḥ·tōw kî ’ên lōw bên tə·nāh- lā·nū ’ă·ḥuz·zāh bə·ṯō·wḵ ’ā·ḇî·nū ’ă·ḥê
verses.literal: Why should the name of our father disappear from his clan because he had no sons Give us property among our father’s brothers

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ וַיַּקְרֵ֥ב מִשְׁפָּטָ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ’eṯ- way·yaq·rêḇ miš·på̄·ṭå̄n lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: So Moses - brought their case before the LORD

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’el- way·yō·mer mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: and the LORD . . . answered him . . .

verses.original: בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָד֮ דֹּבְרֹת֒ כֵּ֗ן נָתֹ֨ן תִּתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת נַחֲלָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲבִיהֶ֑ם אֲחֵ֣י וְהַֽעֲבַרְתָּ֛ אֶת־ אֲבִיהֶ֖ן נַחֲלַ֥ת לָהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nō·wṯ ṣə·lā·p̄ə·ḥāḏ dō·ḇə·rōṯ kên nā·ṯōn tit·tên lā·hem ’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ na·ḥă·lāh bə·ṯō·wḵ ’ă·ḇî·hem ’ă·ḥê wə·ha·‘ă·ḇar·tā ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·hen na·ḥă·laṯ lā·hen
verses.literal: The daughters of Zelophehad speak correctly You certainly must give . . . them property as an inheritance among their father’s brothers and transfer their father’s inheritance to them

verses.original: וְאֶל־ תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כִּֽי־ אִ֣ישׁ יָמ֗וּת אֵ֣ין ל֔וֹ וּבֵן֙ וְהַֽעֲבַרְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ נַחֲלָת֖וֹ לְבִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- tə·ḏab·bêr lê·mōr bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl kî- ’îš yā·mūṯ ’ên lōw ū·ḇên wə·ha·‘ă·ḇar·tem ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw lə·ḇit·tōw
verses.literal: Furthermore you shall say . . . to the Israelites . . . If a man dies and leaves no son you are to transfer - his inheritance to his daughter

verses.original: וְאִם־ אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ בַּ֑ת וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ נַחֲלָת֖וֹ לְאֶחָיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’ên lōw baṯ ū·nə·ṯat·tem ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw lə·ʾɛ·ḥå̄w
verses.literal: If he has no daughter give - his inheritance to his brothers

verses.original: וְאִם־ אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ אַחִ֑ים וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ נַחֲלָת֖וֹ אָבִֽיו׃ לַאֲחֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’ên lōw ’a·ḥîm ū·nə·ṯat·tem ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw ’ā·ḇîw la·’ă·ḥê
verses.literal: If he has no brothers give - his inheritance to his father’s brothers

verses.original: וְאִם־ לְאָבִיו֒ אֵ֣ין אַחִים֮ וּנְתַתֶּ֣ם אֶת־ נַחֲלָת֗וֹ הַקָּרֹ֥ב אֵלָ֛יו לִשְׁאֵר֞וֹ מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּ֖וֹ וְיָרַ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑הּ וְֽהָ֨יְתָ֜ה לְחֻקַּ֣ת מִשְׁפָּ֔ט לִבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה צִוָּ֥ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lə·’ā·ḇîw ’ên ’a·ḥîm ū·nə·ṯat·tem ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw haq·qā·rōḇ ’ê·lāw liš·’ê·rōw mim·miš·paḥ·tōw wə·yā·raš ’ō·ṯāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lə·ḥuq·qaṯ miš·pāṭ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ṣiw·wāh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: And if his father has no brothers give - his inheritance to the next . . . of kin from his clan that he may take possession of it - This is to be a statutory ordinance for the Israelites . . . as the LORD has commanded - Moses

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה עֲלֵ֛ה אֶל־ הַזֶּ֑ה הַ֥ר הָעֲבָרִ֖ים וּרְאֵה֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh ‘ă·lêh ’el- haz·zeh har hā·‘ă·ḇā·rîm ū·rə·’êh ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Go up . . . this mountain of the Abarim range and see - the land that I have given the Israelites . . .

verses.original: וְרָאִ֣יתָה אֹתָ֔הּ אָ֑תָּה גַּם־ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ֥ אֶל־ עַמֶּ֖יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אָחִֽיךָ׃ אַהֲרֹ֥ן נֶאֱסַ֖ף
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’î·ṯāh ’ō·ṯāh ’āt·tāh gam- wə·ne·’ĕ·sap̄·tā ’el- ‘am·me·ḵā ka·’ă·šer ’ā·ḥî·ḵā ’a·hă·rōn ne·’ĕ·sap̄
verses.literal: After you have seen it - you too will be gathered to your people as your brother Aaron was

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה בִּמְרִיבַת֙ בְּמִדְבַּר־ צִ֗ן מְרִיתֶ֨ם פִּ֜י לְהַקְדִּישֵׁ֥נִי לְעֵינֵיהֶ֑ם בַמַּ֖יִם הֵ֛ם מֵֽי־ מְרִיבַ֥ת קָדֵ֖שׁ מִדְבַּר־ צִֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer hā·‘ê·ḏāh bim·rî·ḇaṯ bə·miḏ·bar- ṣin mə·rî·ṯem pî lə·haq·dî·šê·nî lə·‘ê·nê·hem ḇam·ma·yim hêm mê- mə·rî·ḇaṯ qā·ḏêš miḏ·bar- ṣin
verses.literal: for when the congregation contended in the Wilderness of Zin both of you rebelled against My command to show My holiness in their sight regarding the waters Those were the waters of Meribah in Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- Yah·weh lê·mōr
verses.literal: So Moses appealed to the LORD . . .

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָרוּחֹ֖ת לְכָל־ בָּשָׂ֑ר יִפְקֹ֣ד אִ֖ישׁ עַל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·rū·ḥōṯ lə·ḵāl bā·śār yip̄·qōḏ ’îš ‘al- hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: May the LORD the God of the spirits of all flesh appoint a man over the congregation

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ יֵצֵ֣א לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם יָבֹא֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר יוֹצִיאֵ֖ם וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר יְבִיאֵ֑ם עֲדַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹ֤א תִהְיֶה֙ כַּצֹּ֕אן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵין־ לָהֶ֖ם רֹעֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- yê·ṣê lip̄·nê·hem yā·ḇō lip̄·nê·hem wa·’ă·šer wa·’ă·šer yō·w·ṣî·’êm wa·’ă·šer yə·ḇî·’êm ‘ă·ḏaṯ Yah·weh wə·lō ṯih·yeh kaṣ·ṣōn ’ă·šer ’ên- lā·hem rō·‘eh
verses.literal: who will go out - and come in before them - and who will lead them out - and bring them in so that the congregation of the LORD will not be like sheep - without a shepherd

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה קַח־ לְךָ֙ אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֔וּן אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ ר֣וּחַ בּ֑וֹ וְסָמַכְתָּ֥ אֶת־ יָדְךָ֖ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh qaḥ- lə·ḵā ’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn ’îš ’ă·šer- rū·aḥ bōw wə·sā·maḵ·tā ’eṯ- yā·ḏə·ḵā ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: And the LORD replied to Moses Take - Joshua son of Nun a man with vvv the Spirit in him and lay - your hands on him

verses.original: וְהַֽעֲמַדְתָּ֣ אֹת֗וֹ לִפְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֑ה וְצִוִּיתָ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·‘ă·maḏ·tā ’ō·ṯōw lip̄·nê ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·lip̄·nê kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh wə·ṣiw·wî·ṯāh ’ō·ṯōw lə·‘ê·nê·hem
verses.literal: Have him stand - before Eleazar the priest . . . and the whole congregation and commission him in their sight

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֥ה עָלָ֑יו מֵהֽוֹדְךָ֖ לְמַ֣עַן כָּל־ עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ יִשְׁמְע֔וּ
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ‘ā·lāw mê·hō·wḏ·ḵā lə·ma·‘an kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl yiš·mə·‘ū
verses.literal: Confer on him [some of] your authority so that the whole congregation . . . of Israel will obey him

verses.original: יַעֲמֹ֔ד וְלִפְנֵ֨י אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ וְשָׁ֥אַל ל֛וֹ יְהוָ֑ה בְּמִשְׁפַּ֥ט הָאוּרִ֖ים עַל־ פִּ֨יו לִפְנֵ֣י ה֛וּא וְכָל־ בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אִתּ֖וֹ וְכָל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃ יֵצְא֜וּ וְעַל־ פִּ֣יו יָבֹ֗אוּ
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·mōḏ wə·lip̄·nê ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·šā·’al lōw Yah·weh bə·miš·paṭ hā·’ū·rîm ‘al- pîw lip̄·nê hū wə·ḵāl bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’it·tōw wə·ḵāl hā·‘ê·ḏāh yê·ṣə·’ū wə·‘al- pîw yā·ḇō·’ū
verses.literal: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest who will seek counsel for him before the LORD by the judgment of the Urim At his command . . . he and all the Israelites . . . with him the entire congregation will go out . . . . . . and come in

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיַּ֣עַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ צִוָּ֥ה וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַיַּֽעֲמִדֵ֙הוּ֙ לִפְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָּל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·ya·‘aś ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ō·ṯōw ṣiw·wāh way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ way·ya·‘ă·mi·ḏê·hū lip̄·nê ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·lip̄·nê kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: Moses did as the LORD - had commanded him He took - Joshua had him stand before Eleazar the priest . . . and the whole congregation

verses.original: וַיִּסְמֹ֧ךְ אֶת־ יָדָ֛יו עָלָ֖יו וַיְצַוֵּ֑הוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yis·mōḵ ’eṯ- yā·ḏāw ‘ā·lāw way·ṣaw·wê·hū ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh dib·ber bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: and laid - his hands on him and commissioned him as the LORD had instructed through Moses
